notes: Live research (Oct 2026): The official TaiwanICDF page (https://www.icdf.org.tw/wSite/ct?xItem=12505&ctNode=31562&mp=2) confirms the International Higher Education Scholarship Program is a central Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund scheme: it 'offers full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan through collaborations with local universities' under the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) framework, with applications filed through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System (2027 round: 1 Dec 2026 - 15 Mar 2027). Host universities and degree programmes are listed only in the annual Application Guidebook PDF and are assigned through the Fund/TICA framework; no supervising professor or specific institution is attached to the central scholarship. Not applicable per batch rules for central government/cooperation-fund schemes.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official SEARCA page (https://www.searca.org/full-master-phd-scholarships) confirms the Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program is a central intergovernmental scheme run by SEAMEO SEARCA: 'The SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program is fully funded by SEARCA' and 'All applications are evaluated by SEARCA and the respective Ministries of the applicants'. Applicants choose their own study post from six universities (Institut Pertanian Bogor, Universitas Gadjah Mada, Universitas Brawijaya, Kasetsart University, Universiti Putra Malaysia, University of the Philippines Los Banos) and name only a generic 'academic adviser' on the recommendation form; no supervising professor is attached to the central scholarship. Not applicable per batch rules for central government/regional schemes.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official ADB page (https://www.adb.org/work-with-us/careers/japan-scholarship-program) confirms the ADB-Japan Scholarship Program is a central multilateral scholarship financed by the Government of Japan and administered by the Asian Development Bank. Applicants apply directly to their choice of 27 Designated Institutions across Asia and the Pacific (17 in Japan); ADB reviews and recommends awardees. No supervising professor is attached to the central programme; analogous to central Erasmus Mundus. Not applicable per batch rules.

Live research (Oct 2026): The Pragati Scholarship Scheme is a Government of India scheme implemented by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, for girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical institutions at degree (undergraduate) level, applied for through the National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in/All-Scholarships). Awards are a flat Rs 50,000 per year tuition support at any AICTE-approved institution; no supervising professor or institution is attached to the scheme, and undergraduate study grants have no supervision component. Not applicable per batch rules for national government schemes.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Massey University page (https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/undergraduate-international-study-grants) confirms the Undergraduate International Study Grant is an automatic NZ$15,000 tuition-fee contribution for new international students enrolling full-time in one of 15 listed bachelor's degrees in 2027. 'There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission.' The only published contact is the administrative address InternationalRecruitment@massey.ac.nz; no supervising professor, programme faculty, or lab is named anywhere on the scholarship page or its linked regulations, and undergraduate coursework grants have no supervision component. No verified supervisor found.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Massey University page (https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/postgraduate-international-study-grants) confirms the Postgraduate International Study Grant is an automatic NZ$10,000 tuition-fee contribution for new international students enrolling full-time in one of 21 listed master's degrees in 2027. 'There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission, and, if successful, the grant will display on your admission offer of place.' The only published contact is the administrative address InternationalRecruitment@massey.ac.nz; no supervising professor, programme faculty, or lab is named on the scholarship page or its linked regulations, and the taught master's degrees listed carry no scholarship-specific supervisor tie. No verified supervisor found.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Aurora Education Foundation Indigenous Pathways Portal page (https://aurorafoundation.com.au/our-work/indigenous-pathways-portal/scholarships/roberta-sykes-scholarship) confirms the Roberta Sykes Scholarship is a charitable-foundation scholarship administered by the Aurora Education Foundation (co-funded by the National Indigenous Australians Agency, the British High Commission (Chevening), Cambridge Australia Scholarships Ltd, Cambridge Commonwealth Trust and the University of Cambridge) providing supplementary assistance 'to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander postgraduate students who wish to undertake full-time studies at any recognised overseas university'. Listed institutions are open examples (Cambridge, Harvard, New York University, Other, Oxford, University College London) and applicants supply their own confirmation of enrolment and academic referees; no supervising professor or institution is attached to the central scholarship. Not applicable per batch rules for portable foundation schemes (Fulbright-type).
